sources.title: Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023 on Small Business Relief
sources.amendment_history: Art. 2(2) replaced by Ministerial Decision No. 131 of 2026 (issued 2026-07-29)
sources.reuse_retention: Ministry of Finance terms not reviewed (D4); link and cite only
sources.extraction_completeness: full text (3 of 3 pages) read; not stored
sources.notes: Art. 2(1): AED 3,000,000 per tax period (relevant and previous). Art. 2(2): applies to tax periods starting on/after 1 Jun 2023 and only to subsequent periods ending on/before 31 Dec 2026. Art. 3: not for MNE constituent companies or QFZP. Art. 4-5: losses and net interest of SBR periods not carried forward. Art. 6: artificial separation is an avoidance arrangement. Art. 2(2) AMENDED by MD 131/2026 (CT-MD131-2026): now tax periods ending on/before 31 Dec 2029.

sources.notes: Art. 1: replaces MD 73/2023 Art. 2(2): AED 3m threshold applies to tax periods starting on/after 1 Jun 2023 and to subsequent periods ending on/before 31 Dec 2029. English is the MoF's EN version; Arabic prevails.
